verdict.rationale: Flagright publishes an llms.txt, confirmed live by probe (HTTP 200), that opens with an "Instructions for AI Agents" section. That file says any page is available as clean Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL, and points AI clients to a docs MCP server. The probe-2 "Page Not Found" came from a doubled `.md.md` URL, so it does not contradict the Markdown claim. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming the llms.txt and Markdown pages end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://docs.flagright.com/_mcp/server
